business_scope.primary_industry_name: Off-Price Wholesale Liquidation of Branded Overstock Apparel

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (common law framework derived from United States corporate law, with customary law and constitutional overlay)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States (economic provisions)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus)
No comprehensive double taxation agreements currently in force

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Marshall Islands Revised Code (MIRC) Title 51, Business Corporations Act (51 MIRC Chapter 1) as amended; MIRC Title 27 Criminal Code as amended by the Money Laundering (Amendment) Act 2012; Counter-Terrorism and Transnational Organized Crime Act 2018 (CTTOCA); AML/CFT Requirements for Financial Institutions Regulations 2016 as administered by the Banking Commissioner and the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit; UN Security Council Resolution 1373/1267 implementation through CTTOCA designations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in Country of Origin / Competent Passport Issuing Authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home Country Companies Registry / Corporate Affairs Authority

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, and UBOs against the United States OFAC SDN List, United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and RMI domestic counter-terrorism designations under the CTTOCA 2018. Enhanced due diligence is required for politically exposed persons (PEPs), negative media results, and persons connected with high-risk or non-cooperative jurisdictions; screening must be completed and documented by the licensed registered agent prior to name clearance and incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Office of the Registrar of Corporations online filing system (accessible exclusively through RMI-licensed registered agents)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Registrations are processed in English only; corporate names must be expressed in Latin script; non-Latin characters are not accepted; Arabic numerals, hyphens, and standard punctuation are permitted; the name must be distinguishable from all registered domestic and foreign entities and must not misrepresent the entity's purpose or government affiliation.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may, within 15 calendar days, submit a written administrative appeal to the Registrar of Corporations specifying the legal basis for acceptance and attaching the required supporting documentation, including, where applicable, written ministerial consent or licensing evidence for restricted tokens. The Registrar must issue a written determination within 15 business days of receipt. An adverse final determination may be appealed to the High Court of the Marshall Islands pursuant to MIRC Title 51 judicial review procedures. A new name request may be resubmitted at any time upon payment of the applicable availability and filing fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted only in the limited sense that the company must maintain a registered office and registered agent physically located in the Marshall Islands; a home-office or virtual address may be used for operational purposes provided it is not the statutory registered office. For an off-price wholesale liquidation trading entity that does no physical business in the RMI, use of the licensed registered agent's address as the registered office is accepted; however, international banking counterparties will typically require a separate stated business address and operating premise information under correspondent-bank AML expectations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — estimated less than 5% annual probability of unannounced physical inspection for a non-resident Business Corporation with no local premises, no regulated activity license, and no local banking presence; regulatory attention is concentrated on the licensed registered agent rather than the company's foreign trading premises.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act, 2017 (Republic of the Marshall Islands), Chapters 1 and 2; specifically Sections 3, 20, 35, 47, 120 and 155.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (administered through the Office of the Attorney General)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed for a Business Corporation; consideration may consist of cash, tangible or intangible assets, or promissory notes. No escrow, security deposit, or local bank account is required for non-resident entities.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Articles of Incorporation filed with the Registrar on this date be and hereby are adopted, and the Corporation is recognized as duly formed. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the offer, issue and subscription of the authorized common shares to the founding subscriber(s) are approved, and the Secretary is directed to issue stock certificates upon receipt of lawful consideration. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office and registered agent as shown in the Articles are adopted and confirmed. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the following persons are appointed as officers: President, Secretary and Treasurer, to serve until successors are elected. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the officers may open bank accounts and execute required filings in the Corporation's name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations – Business Name Registry (Majuro)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Perform an availability search via the national business name registry. If available, file a name reservation application together with the prescribed name reservation fee. A definitive corporate name must be reserved for use in the Articles of Incorporation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the selected name is rejected due to similarity with an existing entity, submit up to three alternative names for expedited search and reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Filing of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Majuro (or via a licensed Marshall Islands Registered Agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and execute Articles of Incorporation containing the corporate name, registered office, registered agent, authorized share capital, initial directors and purpose. Notarize the incorporator's signature. Submit the articles, name reservation certificate, and government filing fee to the Registrar. The Registrar will issue a Certificate of Incorporation upon satisfaction of formal requirements.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a deficiency notice, cure by filing supplemental or amended articles within 14 working days; technical amendments incur a nominal amendment fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Registered Agent and Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed resident agent to serve as the Corporation's registered agent; provide the agent's consent letter and the physical Marshall Islands street address to be used for service of process. File the registered agent consent form and address details with the Registrar.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the appointed agent is disqualified or the address is rejected, appoint a substitute agent and file the updated consent without delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Share Subscription and Issuance of Shares
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporation Board of Directors (acting by written consent or meeting)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or adopt a unanimous written consent to approve the issue of the initial authorized shares to the subscriber, accept the agreed contribution, and issue share certificates. Record all issuances in the share register.
required_dossiers: Written consent in lieu of meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the subscriber does not tender consideration, the Board may invoke the share subscription agreement and pass a resolution to terminate the subscription and reflect the cancellation in the share register.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Officers and Opening of Bank Accounts
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporation Board of Directors; Corporate Banking Services
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Adopt a board resolution appointing the President, Secretary and Treasurer, and authorizing such officers to open corporate bank accounts and sign documents. File any required beneficial ownership or tax information declarations, and complete bank account opening on-boarding.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the financial institution rejects the application due to incomplete documentation, obtain certified copies from the Registrar and resubmit to an alternative banking partner.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing authority is triggered for non-resident wholesale trading; the Marshall Islands Tourism and Trade Ministry may issue a trade registration certificate if a local operational base is later established.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: N/A – Business Corporation operating as a non-resident exporter/wholesaler without a physical industrial premise; no operating license is required for the off-price garments trading activity.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA) – Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (trading activity without manufacturing or processing)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for pure wholesale trading. In the event of warehousing or distribution activity with vehicle traffic, the EPA requires compliance with the Clean Air and Water Regulations, including Vehicle Inspection Standards and No Waste Disposal Standards, as well as anti-littering requirements.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No local fire safety, structural load, or workplace clearance is required for a non-resident entity with no physical presence. Should the Corporation open a warehouse or office in the Marshall Islands, fire safety certification, structural inspections and occupational health clearance must be secured from the Majuro Fire Department and the Occupational Health and Safety Inspectorate.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Customs Administration (RICA), Ministry of Finance, Majuro Atoll (administers Gross Revenue Tax, Wage Tax, and customs duties; paper-based filings, no national e-portal). Corporate and NRDC registration: Business Corporations Division, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate under the Business Corporations Act (BCA) through a licensed registered agent, filing Articles of Incorporation with the Registrar of Corporations. Step 2: File the annual Non-Resident Domestic Corporation (NRDC) Declaration to perfect the tax-exempt classification; no RICA-issued TIN is needed for an entity with zero RMI-source revenue. Step 3: If the entity ever derives RMI-source gross revenue, register with RICA under the Gross Revenue Tax Act to obtain a TIN and file periodic GRT returns; a pure NRDC liquidating branded overstock apparel entirely offshore remains outside the GRT net and holds no RICA TIN. Step 4: Maintain the registered agent and annual report/NRDC filings to preserve standing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (statutory territorial regime: RMI imposes no income tax, capital gains tax, dividend/interest/royalty withholding tax, or estate tax; the NRDC is also exempt from the 3% Gross Revenue Tax and 8% Wage Tax on all non-RMI source activity, provided the annual NRDC declaration is filed)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, look-through, or hybrid mismatch election exists in RMI law. The operative election is BCA Section 106 NRDC status, elected by filing the NRDC Declaration and paying the prescribed annual fee; revocation occurs automatically on deriving RMI-source income. An RMI LLC may elect entity-level taxation, but no pass-through regime is codified, and hybrid mismatch outcomes are moot because non-resident wholly offshore profits are untaxed.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT, GST, or sales-and-use tax. The only indirect-type levies are the 3% Gross Revenue Tax (GRT) on gross revenue sourced within RMI and customs import tariffs under the Customs Tariff Act; exports of goods from RMI are duty-free and out of scope of the GRT.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: N/A for VAT (no VAT legislation exists). For GRT: RICA registration is triggered at the first dollar of RMI-source gross revenue; no de minimis threshold applies to wholesale trade, but the NRDC's offshore resale of finished garments creates zero RMI-source gross revenue and therefore no registration obligation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, government API, or digital stamping mandate exists. Commercial invoices and standard trade documents are retained in paper or PDF format for audit purposes; customs processes are limited to import declarations only.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: VAT zero-rating does not apply (no VAT system). The functional equivalent under the GRT: revenue from finished garments sold to offshore liquidation buyers is non-RMI source when title and risk of loss pass outside RMI (e.g., FOB/EXW terms with ocean carriage to U.S. or EU buyers), thereby falling outside the 3% GRT base. No export license, export duty, or VAT refund mechanism applies to apparel exports; the NRDC exemption provides a complete refund-free non-taxation outcome.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Commercial invoice with FOB/EXW terms, HS 6201-6217 classification, and foreign destination
Bill of Lading or air waybill evidencing offshore delivery from transshipment hub (e.g., Singapore or Hong Kong) to U.S./EU off-price retailers
Purchase order and vendor liquidation agreement proving acquired overstock from brand owners
SWIFT/ACH inward remittance advices demonstrating settlement from non-RMI bank accounts
NRDC annual declaration filing receipt preserving tax-exempt status
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No FX repatriation deadline or exchange-control regime exists (USD is the domestic currency and is freely convertible). RICA audit risk is limited to mis-declared RMI-source activity: if goods are sold to RMI residents or delivered within RMI, the 3% GRT applies retroactively with monthly late-payment interest, a non-filing penalty of 25% of tax due, and potential criminal fines for wilful evasion; the NRDC status is stripped, exposing the full gross revenue to GRT for the tainted period. No VAT clawback is possible since no VAT was chargeable; the decisive compliance obligation is the truthful annual NRDC declaration of zero RMI-source income.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) — prudential banking supervisor under the Banking Act 1991, as amended. The RMI maintains no independent central bank of issue; the U.S. dollar is the sole legal tender and monetary policy is effectively delegated to the U.S. Federal Reserve System.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMI operates under full dollarization and therefore has no native currency requiring convertibility. Current-account and capital-account transactions are wholly liberalized: trade payments, dividends, interest, capital distributions, and liquidation proceeds may be transferred without exchange-control licensing, profit-remittance approval, or foreign-investment screening. A non-resident Business Corporation (BC) is taxed only on RMI-source income; offshore wholesale-trading income is tax-exempt, with no supplementary withholding or repatriation charge. Practical frictions are limited to correspondent-bank AML/KYC scrutiny of the BC's beneficial-ownership chain.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. The RMI imposes no statutory timeline for bringing export proceeds onshore, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no requirement to hold export receipts with an RMI-licensed bank. USD proceeds from off-price garment liquidation trades may remain in any global USD correspondent, client, or fintech account indefinitely; the entity may freely allocate liquidity across its banking network.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Marshall Islands (BOMI) — Majuro and Ebeye branches

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Settlement Account with Commercial LC and Trade Finance Line

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High for USD-denominated B2B apparel trade settlements in the USD 5,000–250,000 band. Regulated global EMIs (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, Currencycloud) offer compliant MT103/ACH corridors and can accelerate payments to APAC garment suppliers and US/EU off-price retail buyers. Legal constraints: the RMI has no EMI authorization regime, so the EMI must be licensed in its home jurisdiction (FCA, AUSTRAC, HK, or similar), its services are lawful but not prudentially protected in the RMI, and the EMI cannot be the sole custodian of the entity's capital contribution, which must initialize through an RMI-licensed or US-licensed bank ledger to evidence capital and tangible substance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory at BOMI: at least one director or authorized signatory must appear in person at the Majuro branch for biometric verification and original-document inspection. Bank of Guam RMI may permit a two-step remote opening — electronic submission of apostilled corporate documents followed by a live video interview of the UBO — but full remote onboarding without any travel is not available for a non-resident offshore BC. The prudent planning assumption is that one director will travel to Majuro for the in-branch interview and wet-signature execution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore non-resident BC with nominee directors, nominee shareholders, or clustered registered-agent address producing a high-risk geographic and ownership-profile flag under the bank's risk-rating matrix.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled Certificate of Good Standing; certified copy of the Business Corporations Act Charter; current register of directors and shareholders; registered-agent due-diligence letter; UBO declaration with passport copies; corporate organization chart evidencing an economically substantive off-price garment liquidation business; board resolution authorizing account opening; 12-month business plan and cash-flow projection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High payment velocity and invoice-mismatch pattern: low-unit-cost garment purchases from APAC manufacturers (China, Vietnam, Bangladesh) offset by deep-discount sales to US/EU off-price retail chains, creating timing anomalies in the transaction-monitoring system.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fully executed wholesale purchase agreements; pro-forma invoices; packing lists; commercial invoices with INCOTERMS; historical MT103 settlement samples; customs entry declarations; supplier bank reference letters; and an explanatory memorandum detailing the off-price liquidation cycle, discount structure, and recurring payment calendar.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Geographic disconnect among the BC's seat (Pacific), suppliers (APAC), buyers (US/EU), and settlement currency (USD only), triggering enhanced due diligence under the AML Travel Rule and a source-of-funds inquiry.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Professional legal opinion confirming tax-exempt non-resident status and the absence of tax-avoidance motivation; active-business affidavit; source-of-funds evidence (audited financials or verified bank statements of the contributing shareholder); notarized proof of residence for each UBO; and a banker's reference from the previous or parent bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing: injected capital must arrive via SWIFT MT103 (or Fedwire for amounts above USD 100,000 originating in the United States) from the shareholder's account into the entity's Operational USD Settlement Account. The OBI/narrative field must reference the board resolution — e.g., 'SHARE CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION – RESOLUTION NR [XX] DATED [DATE] – MH_BC – ISIC 4641 APPAREL LIQUIDATION TRADING' — and the payment purpose must be coded as an equity contribution (no goods or services associated). The bank will require the apostilled board resolution, the shareholder's source-of-funds letter, and a certified copy of the corporate registry filing prior to the first credit. If seed capital is initially routed through a fintech EMI, it must be swept to the licensed RMI or US bank within the first settlement cycle to establish an auditable new-account ledger and a compliant capital trail.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail: SWIFT MT103 for all supplier and logistics payments above USD 50,000; each instruction must embed the invoice number and ISIC 4641 trade description in the payment narrative. For high-value purchases above USD 250,000 or where supplier documentation requires bank-assured payment, use irrevocable documentary Letters of Credit issued under UCP 600 through Bank of Guam's trade desk or a confirming bank. Secondary rail: ACH Direct for US domestic invoices below USD 10,000 covering freight, warehousing, customs brokers, and operating overhead; weekly Fedwire sweeps to the operational account maintain liquidity concentration control. The treasury protocol requires dual-approval in the electronic banking portal and automated ERP matching of each disbursement against the underlying purchase order, pro-forma invoice, and packing list.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX Forwards (USD vs EUR, GBP, AUD, CAD) for near-dated apparel sale or supplier contracts denominated in those currencies, with tenor up to 12 months, executed through the correspondent bank's treasury desk.

Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) for constrained currencies of garment-supply jurisdictions (e.g., CNY, VND, INR, BDT) where no deliverable local-market forward is available to an RMI entity, executed through the London or Singapore desk under an ISDA or bank Master Agreement.

Cross-Currency Swaps for single large liquidation contracts exceeding USD 5,000,000 involving multi-currency purchase and sale legs, structured under an ISDA CSA with a licensed intermediary, and used only when the natural USD cash-flow offset cannot be achieved by ordinary forwards.
Plain-vanilla FX Swaps and rollovers for short-date liquidity management between invoicing cycles, with exotic or leveraged derivative products expressly excluded under the treasury risk mandate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report of Business Corporation (incorporates franchise tax remittance and confirmation of directors, officers, registered agent, and principal office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Office of the Registrar of Business Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on or before the last day of the anniversary month of incorporation; first filing due within 12 months of the date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing and non-payment attract a US$150 delinquency surcharge plus accrued interest; administrative strike-off and revocation of corporate powers occur if the annual report and franchise tax remain unpaid for 90 days after written notice.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit for a non-resident business corporation engaged in wholesale off-price apparel trading; audit is mandatory only for regulated entities such as banking, insurance, or trust licensees, or where shareholder approval requires an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS is acceptable; non-resident exempt corporations may also maintain books under US GAAP. The Business Corporations Act only mandates books and records accurately reflecting the company's financial affairs.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: On annual report filing, the registered agent must confirm that the beneficial ownership register is current. Any shareholding transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be reported to the registered agent within 21 days of the change; a confirmatory UBO declaration is submitted annually alongside the annual report.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$600 - US$1,200 per year for the licensed registered agent and registered office service
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No statutory audit required; voluntary certified audit for this small non-resident trading entity is estimated at US$1,500 - US$4,500 per year

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption for Non-Resident Domestic Corporations under the RMI Business Corporations Act and Income Tax Act; no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no payroll tax, no net worth tax, no withholding tax on dividends, interest, royalties, or management fees; the only recurring fiscal impost is the annual franchise fee of USD 500 for non-resident business corporations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Non-Resident Domestic Corporation Annual Report (NRDC-AR) filed through the RMI Corporate Registry eFiling Portal (Netteler). No corporate income tax return is required for an exempt non-resident business corporation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing is due on or before the anniversary date of incorporation in each calendar year; the annual franchise fee of USD 500 must accompany the filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name of the corporation as registered in the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must match the name on the Certificate of Incorporation exactly; no trade name or DBAs permitted on this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be a physical RMI address; post office boxes are not sufficient for the registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and address of the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent must be an individual resident in the Marshall Islands or a licensed corporate agent; non-resident entities must maintain this continuously.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and addresses of directors and officers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No RMI residency requirement for directors or officers of a non-resident business corporation; provide full legal names and business addresses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital and share structure.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the number of authorized shares, par value, and classes of stock; for non-resident entities, bearer shares are not permitted.
Certify that the corporation has not derived income from sources within the Marshall Islands, has not carried on commercial business in the RMI, and does not own RMI real property.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the NRDC-AR triggers a penalty of USD 100 per month or portion of a month; if the annual report and fee remain unpaid for more than 60 days, the Registrar may administratively dissolve the corporation and strike its name from the register; reinstatement requires payment of all arrears, penalties, and a reinstatement fee of up to USD 500.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable. The Republic of the Marshall Islands has no comprehensive double taxation agreements in force with any jurisdiction. There is no statutory treaty relief procedure, no tax residency certificate mechanism, and no competent authority for withholding tax relief. Where a foreign shareholder requires proof of status, the Registrar of Corporations may issue a Certificate of Non-Resident Status or Certificate of Good Standing upon payment of the prescribed fee; this certificate is purely factual and does not affect RMI taxation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory RMI withholding rate is 0% for both IP royalties and debt interest paid by a non-resident business corporation to foreign payees. No DTA treaty rate is available because no double taxation agreement exists.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable. The Marshall Islands does not impose a corporate income tax on non-resident business corporations and has no transfer-pricing legislation, no Local File/Master File requirement, and no statutory currency threshold.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: No RMI statutory transfer-pricing regime; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines may be adopted as a risk-management benchmark
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Marshall Islands does not maintain a general economic substance regime comparable to OECD ESR frameworks. However, the Business Corporations Act requires a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation to have no commercial activity, no local-source income, and no RMI real property interests; failure to observe this condition voids the tax exemption. A remote apparel wholesale liquidation entity that merely invoices from the RMI without local operational substance may be disregarded or subject to reclassification in a foreign jurisdiction under its CFC, PFIC, or permanent establishment rules.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Misrepresentation of Non-Resident Status / Shell Company
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Certifying in the NRDC-AR that the entity has no RMI-source income while simultaneously conducting local wholesale sales of finished garments, holding inventory in the Marshall Islands, or soliciting business from persons located in the RMI.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Automatic loss of the non-resident tax exemption; the RMI Registrar may revoke the corporation's non-resident designation, require conversion to a domestic business corporation, and impose a monetary penalty of up to USD 10,000 under the Business Corporations Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign a false declaration become jointly and severally liable for all penalties and unpaid franchise fees; the RMI courts may impose a travel ban prohibiting departure from the Marshall Islands until the liability is settled, and directors may be disqualified from serving as directors or officers of any RMI corporation for a period of five years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the RMI exempt entity as a mere conduit to invoice cross-border finished-garment liquidations without any substantive business presence, while the real management, purchasing, warehousing, and sales decisions occur in a high-tax jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The RMI itself does not impose income tax on the conduit, but the foreign tax authority may disregard the separate existence of the RMI entity, reattribute its profits, and assess penalties for hostile transfer pricing; additionally, under RMI anti-abuse principles, the Registrar may refuse to issue a Certificate of Good Standing if the entity is found to be a shell.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly participate in the sham may be exposed to civil claims in the foreign jurisdiction for conspiracy and dishonest assistance; if foreign tax fraud charges are brought, the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit may cooperate under exchange-of-information agreements, and directors may face extradition for tax-related money laundering where criminal proceeds are traced through RMI bank accounts.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting settlement for wholesale apparel transactions through unexplained third-party payments, high-risk jurisdictions, or transit accounts without conducting customer due diligence and beneficial-ownership screening, particularly when invoice values are inconsistent with the volume of goods.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Anti-Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act 2002, a body corporate convicted of a money-laundering offense is liable to a fine of up to USD 1,000,000; the non-resident corporation may also have its registration suspended for unlawful financial conduct.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers may be prosecuted individually, facing imprisonment of up to 10 years and personal fines of up to USD 250,000; additionally, RMI courts may prohibit the directors from operating any corporate entity within the jurisdiction and may seize assets flowing through RMI accounts.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Annual Filing and Franchise Fee Delinquency
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to submit the annual Non-Resident Domestic Corporation Report and to pay the USD 500 annual franchise fee on or before the anniversary of incorporation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative dissolution of the corporation by the Registrar; the entity loses its legal capacity to enter into enforceable contracts, transfer title, or maintain bank accounts in the corporate name; reinstatement is possible only with payment of all arrears, penalties, and a reinstatement fee.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: If directors continue to trade with dissolved corporate status, they are personally liable for all debts and obligations incurred during the period of non-compliance; the RMI court may grant injunctions preventing the directors from leaving the country and may order the production of personal financial records to satisfy corporate creditors.
